"""Data files for the results dashboard (exp05 + exp01 probes). Reads the results already written by 06_llamea_analyze.py (runs.csv, solutions.csv per campaign), the transfer screens (11_transfer_analyze.py), the step 5c dial screen, 14_bbob_test.py and experiment 1's probe scores, and writes one JSON file per dataset, ``{"rows": [...], "meta": [...]}``, to ``results/dashboard/``. ``meta`` carries this script's own text. Problems and their campaigns (arms paired with control by seed): * MA-BBOB: llamea-dial + llamea-stage1 (seeds 300-307), llamea-stage1-seeds (308-315), llamea-stage1-cal (adaptive_cal, 300-307); * MA-BBOB, budget 200: llamea-ext200 + llamea-ext200-adaptive (300-307); * Bragg / packing: llamea-dial-

+ llamea-stage1-

(400-405); * BBOB f20 20-D: llamea-bbob-f20 (500-509). Usage (from exp05_steering): python scripts/15_dashboard_data.py """ import collections import json from pathlib import Path import numpy as np import pandas as pd HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent EXP = HERE.parent RES = EXP / "results" EXP01 = EXP.parent / "exp01_probing/results/main" OUT = RES / "dashboard" PROBLEMS = { "MA-BBOB": [ "llamea-dial", "llamea-stage1", "llamea-stage1-seeds", "llamea-stage1-cal", ], "MA-BBOB (budget 200)": ["llamea-ext200", "llamea-ext200-adaptive"], "Bragg": ["llamea-dial-bragg", "llamea-stage1-bragg"], "Packing": ["llamea-dial-packing", "llamea-stage1-packing"], "BBOB f20 (20-D)": ["llamea-bbob-f20"], } METRICS = { "best": "best fitness", "auc_best": "area under the best-so-far curve", "failed": "share of algorithms that failed", "n_families": "distinct algorithm families", "div_concepts": "concept diversity", "exploration_pct": "exploration % (traced)", "intensification": "intensification (traced)", } CONCEPTS = [ "population", "differential_evolution", "crossover", "gradient", "step_size_adaptation", "covariance", "local_search", "particle_swarm", "simulated_annealing", "restart", "elitism", "adaptive_parameters", ] SCREENS = { "Bragg": "transfer-bragg", "Packing": "transfer-packing", "BBOB f20 (20-D)": "transfer-bbob-f20", "BBOB f2 (20-D)": "transfer-bbob-f2", } CODE = Path(__file__).read_text() def load(problem): runs, sols = [], [] for tag in PROBLEMS[problem]: d = RES / tag if not (d / "runs.csv").exists(): continue runs.append(pd.read_csv(d / "runs.csv")) sols.append(pd.read_csv(d / "solutions.csv", low_memory=False)) runs = pd.concat(runs).drop_duplicates(["arm", "seed"]) sols = pd.concat(sols).drop_duplicates(["arm", "seed", "idx"]) return runs.rename(columns={"best_aocc": "best"}), sols def curve(g): f = g.sort_values("idx").aocc.astype(float) f = f.where(np.isfinite(f)) return f.fillna(f.min()).cummax().to_numpy() def boot(x, rng, n=4000): b = [rng.choice(x, len(x)).mean() for _ in range(n)] return np.percentile(b, [2.5, 97.5]) def r(v, k=4): return None if v is None or not np.isfinite(v) else round(float(v), k) def main(): OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) rng = np.random.default_rng(0) run_rows, curve_rows, paired_rows, concept_rows = [], [], [], [] for problem in PROBLEMS: runs, sols = load(problem) curves = {k: curve(g) for k, g in sols.groupby(["arm", "seed"])} runs["auc_best"] = [curves[(a, s)].mean() for a, s in zip(runs.arm, runs.seed)] for _, x in runs.iterrows(): run_rows.append( { "problem": problem, "arm": x.arm, "seed": int(x.seed), "evaluations": int(x.n), } | {m: r(x.get(m, np.nan)) for m in METRICS} ) # convergence: mean and quartiles of best-so-far over seeds for arm in runs.arm.unique(): cs = [c for (a, _), c in curves.items() if a == arm] n = min(len(c) for c in cs) m = np.vstack([c[:n] for c in cs]) for i in range(n): curve_rows.append( { "problem": problem, "arm": arm, "evaluation": i + 1, "mean": r(m[:, i].mean()), "q25": r(np.quantile(m[:, i], 0.25)), "q75": r(np.quantile(m[:, i], 0.75)), "seeds": len(cs), } ) # paired differences vs control, and explore - exploit piv = { m: runs.pivot(index="seed", columns="arm", values=m) for m in METRICS if m in runs } pairs = [(a, "control") for a in runs.arm.unique() if a != "control"] pairs += [ (f"{p}explore", f"{p}exploit") for p in ("", "prompt_") if {f"{p}explore", f"{p}exploit"} <= set(runs.arm) ] if "adaptive_cal" in set(runs.arm) and "adaptive" in set(runs.arm): pairs.append(("adaptive_cal", "adaptive")) for a, b in pairs: for m, p in piv.items(): if a not in p or b not in p: continue x = (p[a] - p[b]).dropna().to_numpy() if len(x) < 3: continue lo, hi = boot(x, rng) paired_rows.append( { "problem": problem, "arm": a, "versus": b, "metric": m, "seeds": len(x), "diff": r(x.mean()), "lo": r(lo), "hi": r(hi), "wins": int((x > 0).sum()), "significant": bool(lo > 0 or hi < 0), } ) # concept shares among working algorithms if problem != "MA-BBOB (budget 200)": w = sols[~sols.failed.astype(bool)].copy() w["concepts"] = w.concepts.fillna("").str.split("|") for arm, g in w.groupby("arm"): for k in CONCEPTS: concept_rows.append( { "problem": problem, "arm": arm, "concept": k, "share": r(g.concepts.apply(lambda l: k in l).mean()), "algorithms": len(g), } ) print(problem, len(runs), "runs", flush=True) # f20: final best on the test instances t = pd.read_csv(RES / "llamea-bbob-f20/test.csv") test_rows = [ { "problem": "BBOB f20 (20-D)", "arm": x.arm, "seed": int(x.seed), "train": r(x.train), "test": r(x.test), "gap": r(x.gap), } for _, x in t.iterrows() ] # mechanism: dial dose response on MA-BBOB (step 5c screen) d = pd.read_csv(RES / "dial/summary.csv") dose_rows = [ { "direction": x.direction, "dose": r(x.dose), "samples": int(x.n), "failed": r(x.failed), "aocc": r(x.aocc), "exploration_pct": r(x.exploration_pct), "intensification": r(x.intensification), } for _, x in d.iterrows() ] # mechanism: dose slopes in the single-generation screens slope_rows = [] s = pd.read_csv(RES / "dial/slopes.csv") for _, x in s[s.direction == "b_exploration_pct_resid@L27"].iterrows(): for m in ("exploration_pct", "intensification"): slope_rows.append( { "problem": "MA-BBOB", "phase": "init", "metric": m, "slope": r(x[f"slope_{m}"]), "lo": r(x[f"slope_{m}_lo"]), "hi": r(x[f"slope_{m}_hi"]), "samples": int(x.n), } ) for problem, tag in SCREENS.items(): f = RES / tag / "slopes.csv" if not f.exists(): continue for _, x in pd.read_csv(f).query("phase == 'pooled'").iterrows(): slope_rows.append( { "problem": problem, "phase": "init + refine", "metric": x.metric, "slope": r(x.slope), "lo": r(x.lo), "hi": r(x.hi), "samples": int(x.n), } ) # mechanism: experiment 1 probes per layer (linear probe vs shuffled control) p = pd.read_csv(EXP01 / "probe_scores.csv") probe_rows = [] for _, x in p.iterrows(): binary = x.kind == "binary" probe_rows.append( { "target": x.target, "position": x.position, "layer": int(x.layer), "score": r(x.auroc if binary else x.spearman), "control": r(x.control_auroc if binary else x.control_spearman), "measure": "AUROC" if binary else "Spearman", "samples": int(x.n), } ) inputs = { "runs": "results//runs.csv, solutions.csv", "curves": "results//solutions.csv", "paired": "results//runs.csv, solutions.csv", "concepts": "results//solutions.csv", "test": "results/llamea-bbob-f20/test.csv", "dose": "results/dial/summary.csv", "slopes": "results/dial/slopes.csv, results/transfer-*/slopes.csv", "probes": "exp01_probing/results/main/probe_scores.csv", } for name, rows in [ ("runs", run_rows), ("curves", curve_rows), ("paired", paired_rows), ("concepts", concept_rows), ("test", test_rows), ("dose", dose_rows), ("slopes", slope_rows), ("probes", probe_rows), ]: meta = [ { "label": "15_dashboard_data.py", "value": CODE, "type": "code", "lang": "python", }, {"label": "Input", "value": inputs[name]}, ] (OUT / f"{name}.json").write_text(json.dumps({"rows": rows, "meta": meta})) print(name, len(rows), "rows", flush=True) if __name__ == "__main__": main()
